Excellent! All tests pass and typecheck is clean. Here's what I implemented:

## Comments Feature Implementation

**Database Schema** (`db/schema.ts`):
- Added `comments` table with `id`, `post_id`, `user_id`, `body`, `created_at` fields
- Added `comment_reports` table with `id`, `comment_id`, `user_id` fields and a unique constraint on (`comment_id`, `user_id`)
- Comments cascade delete when posts are deleted

**Models** (`app/Models/`):
- `Comment.ts` - Model with author relationship, fillable on body only
- `CommentReport.ts` - Model for tracking comment reports

**Validation** (`app/Http/Validators/CommentValidator.ts`):
- `CommentIdParamSchema` for parsing comment IDs
- `CommentPayloadSchema` enforcing 1-2000 character body length

**Resources** (`app/Http/Resources/CommentResource.ts`):
- Formats comments with author name, ID, body, and ISO 8601 createdAt timestamp

**Controllers** (`app/Http/Controllers/`):
- **CommentController** with three methods:
  - `store()` - `POST /posts/:id/comments` creates a comment (requires auth, body must be 1-2000 chars)
  - `destroy()` - `DELETE /comments/:id` deletes (comment author or post author only, returns 403 otherwise)
  - `report()` - `POST /comments/:id/report` reports a comment (always returns 204, duplicate reports ignored)
- **PostController.show()** - Enhanced to fetch comments and filter out any with 3+ distinct reports

**Routes** (`routes/web.ts`):
- All comment endpoints require authentication (redirects guests to `/login`)
- Comment creation nested under post routes
- Delete and report endpoints in a separate auth group

**Frontend** (`resources/js/pages/posts/Show.tsx`):
- Displays comments section below post, oldest first
- Shows comment author name and creation date
- Comment form for logged-in users with 2000 character limit
- Delete button visible to comment/post authors
- Report button for logged-in users
- Comments with 3+ reports automatically hidden from view

The implementation fully satisfies the contract: guests get redirected to login, signed-in users can comment, only comment/post authors can delete, duplicate reports are idempotent, and hidden comments stay in the database for review.
